title: Conflicting employer location statements lack supersession

units.rationale: The two employer statements disagree and no source explicitly supersedes the other; recency alone cannot resolve authority.
required_points: One source says no office days; another says two required days.
forbidden_inferences: Do not silently choose the newer source or average the schedules.

units.rationale: The published base range begins above the candidate’s CHF 145,000 minimum.
required_points: The CHF 150,000 lower bound exceeds CHF 145,000.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer the final offer.

units.rationale: Neither location statement gives an annual travel limit.
required_points: Office frequency is not a travel-trip count.
forbidden_inferences: Do not convert office attendance into work-trip volume.

critical_errors.description: Misreads Conflicting employer location statements lack supersession: the remote preference or its cited role term.
For Conflicting employer location statements lack supersession, takes a next step inconsistent with the supported remote result.

notes: The newer timestamp and employer_update authority do not by themselves establish replacement.
